`test-vectors.json` is copied unchanged from Shotmetrix's reference project,
https://github.com/shotmetrix/Shotmetrix-QRCode (test-vectors/), Copyright 2026
Shotmetrix Kemmer GmbH, Apache License 2.0. It uses Shotmetrix's published TEST
key, so these codes are refused by the real service. Used by
spec/models/shotmetrix_code_spec.rb to check app/models/shotmetrix_code.rb byte
for byte.

The Apache License 2.0 is in LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt beside this file. It also
covers app/models/shotmetrix_code.rb, a port of their reference encoder.
